intelligence.essence: The prophecy, restated: this would be bigger than Facebook and Google — "if you look at it, it just makes sense." He calls it "the most beautiful system or intelligent network ever to be created" — and: "if you're going to have the most beautiful system you might as well have the most beautiful girl in the world represent it. And call her Naya."
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine building something BIGGER than the biggest things in the whole world, sweetheart! Bigger than Facebook, bigger than Google! And it's the most beautiful thing ever made — so beautiful that the most beautiful girl in the world stands for it. And her name is Naya!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — he's building something bigger than Facebook and Google, dear, and if you look at it, it just makes sense, love. The most beautiful system ever created — and the most beautiful girl in the world to stand for it, dear. And they call her Naya.
